summary: Round r1 (restricted network). Primary documents were located for (1) US trade preferences available to Nepal: the Nepal Trade Preference Program (TFTEA Section 915, Proclamation 9555, USTR annual implementation reports, OTEXA product list), the lapsed US GSP (CRS RL33663) and the 2025 reciprocal-tariff executive orders that now overlay MFN treatment; and (2) US development cooperation: the 2022 USAID-Nepal DOAG, the 2025 pause/termination of USAID awards, the MCC Nepal Compact (MCA-Nepal procurement notice, OIG financial audit) and OECD CRS / ForeignAssistance.gov series. Search results report that the NTPP authorisation ended at the close of calendar 2025 without renewal and that the MCC Compact was allowed to continue in 2025; both are unverified until the statute, proclamation and MCC/US Embassy primary records are retrieved. No values retrieved; every empirical item is pending.

findings.claim: Legal status and end date of the Nepal Trade Preference Program (whether TFTEA s.915 authority terminated on its statutory sunset and whether any extension was enacted after 2025).
findings.note: Retrieve L01 (sunset clause), L02, L04, L05; check congress.gov for any 2026 reauthorisation bill. Search results (secondary, L13) report lapse at end of 2025 - unverified.

findings.claim: NTPP utilisation: US imports from Nepal claimed under NTPP and share of total US imports from Nepal, by calendar year.
findings.note: USTR annual NTPP report tables (L04) and USITC DataWeb by special programme indicator; calendar year - convert to Nepal FY only via monthly data.

findings.claim: US GSP status for Nepal: authorisation lapse date, any 2025-2026 renewal legislation, and whether duties paid during the lapse would be refunded retroactively.
findings.note: CRS RL33663 (L08) and congress.gov bill texts; historical GSP-claimed imports from Nepal from USITC DataWeb.

findings.claim: Tariff rate applied to Nepal-origin goods under the 2025 reciprocal-tariff executive orders (baseline or Annex I rate), with product-scope exemptions, and interaction with NTPP/GSP.
findings.note: Retrieve Annex I of L10 and L11 and scope annex of L12; record effective dates; verify whether later court rulings or orders modified them.

findings.claim: USAID DOAG (May 2022) commitment, obligated and disbursed amounts to date, and status of each development objective after the 2025 pause and award terminations.
findings.note: L14 for headline commitment; MoF Development Cooperation Report (see 18D) and AMIS for disbursement by Nepal FY; OECD CRS (L21) for calendar-year disbursements; ForeignAssistance.gov via L22.

findings.claim: MCC Nepal Compact: total MCC grant, Government of Nepal contribution, amounts disbursed to date, compact end date after the March 2026 amendment, and status of Electricity Transmission and Road Maintenance projects.
findings.note: L18 (audited expenditure Apr 2024-Mar 2025), L19 (funding envelope), MCC compact amendment text (not yet located), L20; OECD CRS donor code for MCC.

findings.claim: US ODA gross disbursements to Nepal by year and sector (OECD CRS), compared with MoF DCR records of US disbursements.
findings.note: CRS (calendar year, donor-reported) vs DCR/AMIS (Nepal FY, recipient-reported) differ methodologically; keep both.

findings.claim: US monetary-policy spillover to Nepal (Fed policy rate path affecting external borrowing cost and INR/USD, hence NPR/USD via the peg).
findings.note: Supporting role for X20 (16A); monthly Fed H.15 and RBI series owned by 20A. No value recorded here.

findings.claim: Preference analysis treats NTPP, GSP and reciprocal tariffs as three distinct legal layers; the applied US duty on a Nepali product is determined by all three together with the HTSUS MFN rate, and each is recorded separately with its effective date.

US development-cooperation stages are defined as: commitment (agreement signed) > obligation (US funds obligated) > disbursement (funds paid out) > expenditure (audited). Only disbursement enters the model (grants channel); the other stages are context.
No inference is made about future US policy intentions; scenarios use documented legal status only, with alternative states (renewed / lapsed) as labelled scenario assumptions.

data_gaps: MCC Compact amendment of March 2026 text not located as a primary document.
ForeignAssistance.gov country series for Nepal not located directly (only a secondary aggregator).
USITC DataWeb extraction for imports under special programme indicator for Nepal not yet planned as a lead.
No primary MoF notice located for the 2025 USAID award terminations; secondary press only.
Status of 2025 reciprocal tariffs after any 2026 legal challenges is not established.

assumptions.text: NTPP, GSP and reciprocal tariffs are recorded as separate legal layers with effective dates.
Commitment, obligation, disbursement and expenditure are kept as distinct stages; only disbursement enters model grants.
Calendar-year US/OECD series are not mixed with Nepal FY DCR series without monthly/quarterly conversion.

challenges.text: X12 (trade preferences) lists 18C as support but not 18A; US NTPP/GSP lapse and 2025 reciprocal tariffs should be added as a US layer, with 18A as supporting agent.
Preference-erosion analysis for the US market must treat NTPP expiry and US GSP lapse as events independent of LDC graduation; do not attribute them to graduation.
MCC Compact is a grant; ensure it is not counted in external debt; DCR and CRS record it differently (recipient FY vs donor calendar year).
Request red-team review of scenario treatment of US aid volatility (2025 pause/terminations) as a precedent for S08/S10 stress tests.

uncertainty: High. No primary document was downloaded; the lapse of NTPP, the continuation of the MCC Compact and the termination of USAID awards are reported by search snippets and secondary press only. US trade measures changed frequently in 2025-2026 and may have been modified after the latest located documents.

preference_status.method: Record each US preference layer as a dated legal-status record (authority, start, statutory end, renewal status, product coverage) plus annual utilisation from USTR/USITC; overlay 2025 reciprocal tariff rates by effective date.

layers.reported_state_unverified: reported lapsed at end of calendar 2025; extension requested by Nepal

layers.programme: US GSP (Title V, Trade Act of 1974)
layers.reported_state_unverified: authorisation lapsed end of calendar 2020; renewal bills pending
rate applicable to Nepal not yet read from annex

preference_status.period_basis: calendar year (US); convert via monthly USITC data for Nepal FY

cooperation_flows.method: For each instrument record commitment, obligation, disbursement and audited expenditure separately with period basis; reconcile OECD CRS (donor, calendar year) with MoF DCR/AMIS (recipient, Nepal FY) and keep both.

instruments.instrument: Other US agencies (State, USDA etc.) via CRS
